I would like to bring up the following consensus spec PR:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4476

This is an alternative to [#3510](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3510). At ACDC about a month ago, we decided to hold off on merging this change until after Fulu. There has been renewed interest in merging one of these PRs sooner. It would make rebasing EIP-7732 to Fulu simpler and is somewhat necessary to start working on EIP-7782 specs.

cc @flcl42

> Plan to check the real gas cost of secp256r1 this week.

I saw this point last week and wanted to share a besu benchmark using our latest (unreleased) implementation of r1 p256verify on an m6a.2xlarge...

Note, the derived gas cost is based on a arbitrary standard burn rate target of 100MGps. I'm not sure there's wide agreement about this standard rate? Historically it was 35MGps but this is clearly too low for gas estimation now.

```
Benchmarks for p256VerifyPerf on fork Osaka

**** Calculate the derived gas from execution time with a target of 100 mgas/s *****
*                                                                                  *
*   If 247,914 ns is the execution time of the precompile call, so this is how     *
*                the derived gas is calculated                                     *
*                                                                                  *
*   100,000,000 gas    -------> 1 second (1_000_000_000 ns)                        *
*   x           gas    -------> 247,914 ns                                         *
*                                                                                  *
*	x = (247,914 * 100,000,000) / 1_000_000_000 = 24,791 gas                   *
************************************************************************************

Native p256Verify - PERF
--attempt-cache-bust=true (--warm-time and --exec-time ignored)
--warm-iterations=15000
--exec-iterations=1000
                               |  Actual cost | Derived Cost |  Iteration time |      Throughput
p256verifyPerf                 |    6,900 gas |    5,157 gas |     51,574.3 ns |     133.79 MGps

****************************** Hardware Specs ******************************
* VM Type: m6a.2xlarge
* OS: GNU/Linux Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS (Noble Numbat) build 6.14.0-1009-aws
* Processor: AMD EPYC 7R13 Processor
* Microarchitecture: Zen 3
* Physical CPU packages: 1
* Physical CPU cores: 4
* Logical CPU cores: 8
* Memory Total: 32 GB
```

For comparison, here's our (recently improved and also unreleased) k1 ecrecover
```
Native EcRecover - PERF
--attempt-cache-bust=true (--warm-time and --exec-time ignored)
--warm-iterations=15841
--exec-iterations=990
                               |  Actual cost | Derived Cost |  Iteration time |      Throughput
ecrecover_perf                 |    3,000 gas |    4,088 gas |     40,876.5 ns |      73.39 MGps
```

More details here:
https://github.com/hyperledger/besu-native/pull/277#issuecomment-3146705490
